LanguageData.LP_E3_DivineGlance.label: noticed by a god
LanguageData.LP_E3_DivineGlance.description: Gave alms to an avatar of a god. The god remembers this person.
LanguageData.LP_E3_DivineDispleasure.label: divine displeasure
LanguageData.LP_E3_DivineDispleasure.description: Struck an avatar of a god. Nothing goes right.
LanguageData.LP_E3_SilverFriend.label: friend of the silver dragon
LanguageData.LP_E3_SilverFriend.description: Spent many nights talking with a silver dragon in mortal guise. Cold-hardy, and steadier of heart.
LanguageData.LP_E3_GiftedWard.label: magic prodigy
LanguageData.LP_E3_GiftedWard.description: A child with too much innate magic: learns especially fast, and magic bursts out when emotions run wild (wild magic). On coming of age at 13, can become a wizard if Intellectual is high enough.
LanguageData.LP_E3_Shadowed.label: invisible prowl
LanguageData.LP_E3_Shadowed.description: The thieves' guild's invisibility. Revealed when anyone comes within 5 cells.
LanguageData.LP_E3_Wooden.label: wooden body
LanguageData.LP_E3_Wooden.description: Awakened tree: fears fire, takes double fire damage.
LanguageData.LP_E3_TrapWounds.label: trap wound
LanguageData.LP_E3_TrapWounds.description: Stepped into trap after trap; the pace has slowed.
LanguageData.LP_E3_TarrasqueHide.label: Tarrasque carapace
LanguageData.LP_E3_TarrasqueHide.description: A carapace thicker than city walls. Its strength depends on how dangerous the world was when it woke (threat points).
LanguageData.LP_E3_TarrasqueHide.stages.0.label: newly woken
LanguageData.LP_E3_TarrasqueHide.stages.1.label: hardened
LanguageData.LP_E3_TarrasqueHide.stages.2.label: immortal
